title: a create's initialInput is delivered and submitted
asserts: a prompt carried on the create is pasted into the session AND submitted, without the client having to append a newline of its own: the stand-in only acts on a line it has been given in full, so the title it sets is proof both that the text arrived and that an Enter followed it. This is the dispatch path — an oracle dispatch is a create with initialInput and nothing else — and a core that writes the prompt without submitting it leaves the agent sitting with it typed, so nothing runs and no activity edge ever fires.

steps.note: no trailing newline, which is what an oracle dispatch sends
the delivery engine waits for the CLI to be up, confirms the paste landed, then sends the Enter separately, so this is the boot window plus a verified round trip
